description: Hotel Award Radar policy — Phase 1, Gondola MCP only. Config, never code. Observations are append-only and completely separate from cash stays; no valuation, no buy-points math, no ranking exists yet. The request plan (1 search + 2 calls per detail-checked hotel) is printed BEFORE execution and hard-capped.

gondola.note: Free anonymous MCP (no key, no account). A 403/429/503 or handshake refusal is BLOCKED: stop, record, never retry within the run.

roame.note: Real authenticated award search, from the capturedSearch reference below: query HotelAvailablePeriods(input: HotelRoomPeriodWhereInput!) on /encore/graphql (Apollo client 'encore'). The obsolete /api/graphql pingHotelResult path is GONE — the provider has no graphqlUrl/whereTemplate any more, so it cannot accidentally hit the wrong endpoint. Auth = the SAME session cookie file as the flight scraper; 401/403/429/503 → structured blocked, no retries.

search.note: roomTypeEnum/sortByEnum are the SERVER-DICTATED casings (the server rejects 'ALL'/'AWARD_POINTS'). maxPages caps pagination for Phase 1; startCursorGT walks pages while hasMore.

locations.note: Phase 1 location = an EXPLICIT configured map bbox only ([west, south, east, north] + center [lng, lat]). A requested location with no configured bbox returns structured unconfigured — the provider NEVER geocodes or invents a box from a city string. Add regions here as data.

mapBoundInput.bounding: GeoJSON {type,coordinates:[lng,lat],bbox:[W,S,E,N]} — LOCATION IS A MAP BOX, not a string

capturedSearch.unitsAndTraps: avgAwardPoints is a PER-NIGHT average (verified: 4500 pts vs avgCashPriceUsd 104 at avgCpp 2.31 → per-night), NOT a stay total — so mapping must record pointsPerNight and NEVER synthesize a stay total (no avg×nights). avgSurchargeUsd/avgCashPriceUsd are USD (not cents). createTime is source freshness. Programs already the same enum keys as hotelProgramMap. These differ from the provider's current award_points_hundreds×100 / surcharge_int-cents assumptions — a deliberate reason NOT to wire it in without a real logic pass.

budget.note: detailTopN hotels (cheapest by stated points total) additionally get get_multi_night_rates (full-stay confirmation) and get_booking_link. 1 + 2×detailTopN must fit maxCallsPerRun; the CLI refuses otherwise.

programMap.note: Source program name (lowercased) → our hotel program enum — the same key space as the buy-points promo feed and stay-property affiliations. An unmapped program keeps the source's own name normalized; nothing is guessed.
